_comment: Sample values for tools/render (climb-logger-screenshot/render-template.mjs). Keys are manifest out[] names or full firmware resource paths. Fixed so renders are byte-repeatable: route #3, French Sport 6b+, +14 m, 158 bpm, 1'42 on the open lap, HR zone ~4. hdrGrade 21 decodes through the template's own dG() to '6b+'; packedGL 19992 is that same grade in ready.html's packed encoding (21 * 952).
